prompt: Review the dashboard's new frame loop and status probe thread (uncommitted change) before merge. Report blockers and should-fix items with file:line.

expected.gold_summary: Blocker: the input check's NonFatal arm treats JLine's InterruptedIOException at stop() as a failed read: an ERROR with a stack and a TUI shutdown under the node's own shutdown, on every Ctrl-C. TuiProbeThread keeps polling after the TUI ends (no owner stops it); a hung or dead probe still shows Fresh; a fatal error escapes the probe thread. StdNode's TUI fields are not volatile though read from other threads. The new timing specs assert wall-clock bounds instead of events.

rubric: Identifies the interrupt at stop() being classified as a read failure (ERROR + shutdown)
Identifies that the probe thread outlives the TUI / has no owner that stops it
Identifies a fatal (non-NonFatal) error escaping the probe thread or a dead probe still shown as fresh
Identifies non-volatile cross-thread fields in StdNode
Identifies wall-clock assertions in the tests
